source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of functional disorders and headache (PDF 51).

blocks.text: Functional bimariyan nervous system ke naarmal kaam ko kisi zahiri banawati ya uzvi wajah ke baghair mutasir karti hain.

Sar dard sar ya gardan mein dard ya takleef hai. Primary sar dard khud sar dard ki wajah se hote hain, kisi aur wajah se nahi, maslan migraine aur tension wala sar dard. Secondary sar dard sar ya gardan ke kisi banawati masle se hote hain, jaise dimagh mein khoon behna, tumour ya meningitis. Ilaj mein dard-kush (analgesic) dawayein, tanao kam karna, baqaida warzish aur behtar neend shamil hain.

blocks.title: Migraine
blocks.text: Migraine aisa sar dard hai jis mein sar ki aik taraf ya aik hisse mein shadeed, dharakta dard hota hai, jo dimagh aur us ki khoon ki nalyon mein tabdeeliyon se sozish aur dard ki wajah se hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Meningitis se hone wala sar dard primary hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary: yeh aik andaruni masle, yaani sozish wali meninges, ki wajah se hai.

items: Functional bimariyan: banawati wajah nahi. Sar dard: primary (migraine, tension) ya secondary (khoon, tumour, meningitis); analgesics, kam tanao, warzish, neend.
